work.name: University of Wisconsin–Madison | NSF HAND ERC
work.position: Graduate Research Assistant — Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
work.summary: Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation for Real-World Jar Opening
highlights: Developed reinforcement learning policies for bimanual dexterous manipulation, coordinating a dual-arm, multi-fingered robot system for stable grasp acquisition and continuous jar twisting.

Designed a geometric grasp representation and a three-stage curriculum to support grasp acquisition and subsequent twisting, while enabling emergent finger-gait behaviors beyond hand kinematic limits.

Built massively parallel GPU simulation environments with mjlab and MuJoCo Warp, and trained PPO policies with progressive domain randomization over object properties, robot control, and observations for robust sim-to-real transfer.

Deployed the learned policies on a real dual-Franka platform with TESOLLO dexterous hands, integrating RGB-D object state estimation and real-time robot control to evaluate generalization across diverse household containers.

work.name: University of Wisconsin–Madison | NSF HAND ERC
work.summary: Non-Verbal Human Behavior Understanding for Interactive VLA Systems
highlights: Developing a System 1–System 2 architecture for non-verbal human-robot interaction, translating human behavior into semantic interpretations, robot instructions, and executable actions.

Designed a two-stage System 1 pipeline using Qwen vision-language models, with a fast VLM for interpreting human gestures and human-object interactions followed by a reasoning VLM that generates context-aware robot instructions.
Integrated π0.5 VLA as System 2 to execute the generated instructions through vision-conditioned robot actions, enabling robot interaction driven by non-verbal human cues.

work.name: University of Wisconsin–Madison
work.summary: Immersive Robotic Telepresence via Online 3D Gaussian Splatting
highlights: Developed an end-to-end immersive robotic telepresence system on a Stretch 2 robot, integrating online 3D reconstruction, rendering, and streaming for low-latency remote interaction.

Developed an online 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipeline for real-time scene reconstruction, achieving high-fidelity rendering under onboard compute constraints with over 4× speedup compared with the baseline pipeline.
